ENG: #T Forbid [Character.GetShortUIName] from being a $knight_culture_player$#!\n\n[Character.GetShortUIName] may #emphasis never#! join your [armies|E] as a $knight_culture_player_no_tooltip$. This keeps [Character.GetHerHim] safe from dying in [battle|E].

[Character.GetSheHe|U] may take the place of a $knight_culture_player_no_tooltip$ with higher Prowess.
